in_sanskrit.name: आयुर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: the principle of life, the principle of longevity

in_marathi.name: Ayur
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayur is a Sanskrit name derived from the Ayurvedic concept of 'Ayus' which means 'life'. It represents the vital force that sustains life and promotes health and longevity. This name is considered auspicious and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
